steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-pt=src-locate-bar]').getBoundingClientRect(); const hits = [...document.querySelectorAll('.rows2 .ocard, .rows2 button')].filter(e => !e.closest('[data-pt=src-locate-bar]')).filter(e => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.left < b.right && r.right > b.left && r.top < b.bottom && r.bottom > b.top; }).map(e => (e.id || e.className) + ' ' + e.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, '').slice(0, 12)); return JSON.stringify(hits); })()

steps.eval: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#res-field_fiber.source-spot'); const cs = getComputedStyle(c); const ext = (parseFloat(cs.outlineWidth) || 0) + (parseFloat(cs.outlineOffset) || 0); const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); let p = c.parentElement; while (p && getComputedStyle(p).overflow === 'visible') p = p.parentElement; const q = p.getBoundingClientRect(); const cut = []; if (r.top - ext < q.top) cut.push('上'); if (r.bottom + ext > q.bottom) cut.push('下'); if (r.left - ext < q.left) cut.push('左'); if (r.right + ext > q.right) cut.push('右'); return cut.join(''); })()
